DNA B JJ C lub Management A pp — Partner B riefing Prepared June 2026 What We're Building D NA is a mobile gym management app built specifically for B JJ clubs. It runs on a coach's phone and handles the day-to-day admin that currently lives in spreadsheets, group chats, and paper — student rosters, attendance tracking, belt stripe progression, and digital waivers. The app is coach-facing only. Students interact with it in one way: scanning a QR code to sign their annual waiver. Where We Are Now Phase 1 — Demo (Complete) We built a fully functional mobile demo of the app. It looks and behaves like a real native app but runs entirely in the browser with no backend. Every feature is wired up visually: • Student roster with belt level and stripe bar • Per-student attendance tracking with 6-month history • B elt stripe awarding with date logging (4 stripes per belt) • D igital waiver signing via QR code • Waiver status on each student profile (signed / expiring / missing) Phase 2 — Real Backend (In Progress) We are now replacing the demo's local browser storage with a real database and A PI. Progress so far: • GitHub repo created for the backend (dna-bjj-api) • Supabase project set up — database, auth, and file storage in one place • A ll core database tables created (students, stripes, attendance, waivers) • A uthentication setup is underway (step 3 of 5) Tech Stack

# Page 2^page=2
Frontend React, Tailwind C SS, React Router Backend Node.js + Express Database Supabase (PostgreSQL) Auth Supabase A uth — email/password for coaches File Storage Supabase Storage (for waiver PD Fs) Hosting Railway or Render (planned) Repo GitHub (private) Core Features Student Roster C oaches manage a full roster of students. Each student has a profile with name, email, belt level, join date, waiver status, and their complete attendance and stripe history. Belt Stripe Tracking In B JJ, each belt has 4 stripes before promotion to the next belt. C oaches tap a stripe to award it and log the date. The stripe bar appears directly under the student's name throughout the app — 4 dark segments, each lighting up white when earned. Attendance C oaches take attendance per session with a single tap. Each student's profile shows a 6-month rolling summary. Months with zero attendance are flagged so coaches can follow up. Digital Waivers C oaches display a QR code on their phone. Students scan it, read the waiver, and sign digitally. The waiver auto-attaches to the student's profile by email match. A ll waivers expire January 1st each year and must be re-signed annually. What’s Next • Finish auth (coaches only — no student accounts needed) • B uild and test all A PI routes (students, attendance, waivers, stripes) • Set up Supabase Storage for waiver PD F uploads • D eploy A PI to Railway / Render • Wire the demo frontend to the live backend
